findings.strum: 65 down-crossings and 65 brackets; 64 intervals 460.384–534.070ms, no short/long interval flags. No unexplained approximately one-second interval in this trial; historical unexplained intervals remain unresolved. Intended-gesture ground truth is unavailable.
findings.comparisons: Tap first-light landing is closer than earlier compatible owner result (48.532 versus166.705ms absolute), but earlier trial overlapped automation. Tap stay-a-little and Strum first-light have no earlier full compatible result. No training-gain or controlled-repeatability claim.

refinementImplications: Validate whether strong category wording matches perceived severity: first-light Tap drift is approximately1.35% slower than its opening, Strum approximately0.71% faster. Arithmetic matches current rules; these trials do not justify changing scoring thresholds.
Owner subsequently confirmed results felt right and explicitly deferred tweaks/polish until the functional MVP is complete. No concrete UI defect or scoring-threshold change requested.
Keep compatible comparison boundaries explicit: a longer-gap Tap and a Strum trial cannot substantiate improvement over short-gap Tap.

phase2Gate.reliableCoreLoop: Supported on tested iPhone built-in speaker by autonomous checks and three completed actual owner trials with verified saved metrics. Broader device/route claims remain unsupported.
phase2Gate.immediatelyUnderstandable: Owner completed requested modes and an additional challenge and gave positive feedback; unaided comprehension/result interpretation not explicitly observed.
phase2Gate.meaningfullyMoreEngagingThanClickOnly: Positive impression supports appeal but does not establish click-trainer familiarity or comparative preference.
phase2Gate.voluntaryRetry: Three new completed trials are observed, but prompting/reasons for the additional Tap challenge are unknown; no spontaneous retry claim.
phase2Gate.scoreTrust: Owner directly confirms results felt right. This establishes perceived fairness of tested rounds; controlled repeated-identical-result trust remains unestablished/deferred.
phase2Gate.accessibilityScope: Phase2 foundations have programmatic direct-touch checks, physical maximum Dynamic Type/preparation audit, and simulator reduced-motion/contrast evidence. Actual VoiceOver-use remains unobserved. Full accessibility review is Phase4, not an added broad Phase2 certification gate.
phase2Gate.decision: Accepted for MVP construction under explicit owner-directed sequencing revision; broader comparison/polish deferred, not empirically passed.
